title: 2004 AMC 10A Problem 19
statement: A white cylindrical silo has a diameter of \(30\) feet and a height of \(80\) feet. A red stripe with a horizontal width of \(3\) feet is painted on the silo, as shown, making two complete revolutions around it. What is the area of the stripe in square feet?

solutions.text:
Unrolling the stripe flattens it into a parallelogram. Its base (the horizontal width) is \(3\) feet and its height spans the full \(80\) feet of the silo.

The area is therefore \[ 3 \times 80 = 240 \] square feet.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Imagine cutting the stripe from the silo and unrolling it flat
It becomes a parallelogram with horizontal width \(3\) and height \(80\)
